text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After the first "Dream Fest"— public 
interest in racing had grown even higher 
than before.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: —Ah, that's right! This is the girl, <chrname>!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
"I've gotten totally hooked! I'm gonna be 
cheering them on from now on. Looks like 
I'll be hitting the racetrack regularly 
again!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even just walking through town, you could 
hear voices full of anticipation not only 
for the 'Dream Fest', but for the entire 
Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
"Still, we really picked a great time to 
come back, didn't we? I mean, pretty 
soon...—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In Umamusume racing, classifications are 
divided by generation. The first year is 
the Junior Class, and the following year 
is the Classic Class.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, they belong to the Senior 
Class. Among these, the most important are 
the once-in-a-lifetime Classic 
Class-exclusive races—

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
—It's starting again this year! The 
Classic season...!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Every race is exciting, of course, but the 
heat of the Classic races is truly 
something special!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
When skills are evenly matched, their true 
mettle is tested as they clash! The sheer 
intensity of it all is incredible!

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
And of course, will a historic record be 
achieved or not? You just can't help but 
wonder～.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The Classic Triple Crown, achieved by 
conquering the royal road of the Satsuki 
Sho, Japanese Derby, and Kikuka Sho—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Or perhaps the Triple Tiara of the Tiara 
route, achieved by winning the Oka Sho, 
the Oaks, and the Shuka Sho...
choice_data_list:
Becoming a Triple Crown Uma Musume is the 
greatest honor there is!

text_block_list.name: Junior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Speaking of which, when it comes to 
the Classic Triple Crown...!

text_block_list.name: Junior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
St Lite! That's the first time I've ever 
seen him in person!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—St Lite. The very first "Classic Triple 
Crown Umamusume" in history.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After claiming the Triple Crown, she 
retired from her racing career only a year 
later. Leaving behind nothing but a 
brilliant, dazzling light—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Haiseiko, who continues to thrive in the 
limelight; Speed Symboli, whose activities 
any academy member hears about due to her 
role at the URA...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unlike them, no information ever surfaced 
about St Lite after she retired from 
racing.

text_block_list.name: Junior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I've looked up to them ever since I 
entered this world! But they're so 
legendary... I never thought I'd actually 
meet them!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Your parents are... noble aristocrats from 
the UK, if I remember correctly!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I've heard rumors about it in high 
society ever since I was a child, so... 
it's truly an honor!

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Haha, you two are full of energy. My 
heart's still pounding so fast, I can 
barely speak...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even while I was having someone help with 
<chrname>'s training...

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text: No. I was merely watching.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text: Heh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I learn so much from her every day. Her 
assistance with training is spot-on and an 
enormous help, but...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"...Come to think of it! Right now, the 
Umamusume Museum has a special exhibition 
on the Classic Triple Crown."

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
It looks like there are materials on St. 
Lite as well. Perhaps we can learn more 
about her.

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"Sounds good! <chrname> is in the Classic Class 
right now, after all... Could be some good 
motivation, right?"

text_block_list.name: Trendy Fan A
text_block_list.text: —Huh, the Triple Crown exhibition...

text_block_list.name: Longtime Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly! It's super exciting! Triple 
Crown Umamusume don't come around often, 
you know, so once you start looking into 
it, you fall down the rabbit hole~.

text_block_list.name: Trendy Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'm new to 'Dream Fest'. For now, 
just getting to know my oshi is plenty 
enough for me.

text_block_list.name: Longtime Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Still, if your favorite becomes a Triple 
Crown Umamusume, it'll be an unforgettable 
memory for life, you know? Plus, the more 
you know, the twice as moving it is, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Trendy Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Well, I just love my fave, that's 
all! Results don't really matter. As long 
as they're having fun running, that's 
plenty for me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day after talking with the senior 
Trainers. When I paid a visit to the 
museum adjacent to Tokyo Racecourse...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Oh, good day to you.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"It seems Orfe-san is also interested in 
the same special exhibition."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Deducing from the situation, you seem to 
be... the same as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As things turned out, the three of them 
headed to the museum in complete 
silence...

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text: Welcome, my darlings.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Good day. It is an honor to meet you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Both Orfevre and Gentildonna rein in their 
arrogant attitudes around him... That 
alone shows just what an immense presence 
St Lite is.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
Please, have a look. I have just added 
some materials.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
This is my photo album. —From when I 
achieved the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Let us have a look.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
The "birthplace of modern Umamusume 
racing," the United Kingdom. Modeled after 
their tradition and established here— is 
the Classic Triple Crown route.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
Back then, winning the Classic Triple 
Crown was considered impossible in the 
Japanese racing world.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
'The fastest,' 'the luckiest,' and 'the 
strongest'... No one can satisfy all 
three. Thus, born to fulfill every single 
one was—

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text: ――This has been St Lite.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"...―― Is this right after winning the 
Classic Triple Crown?"

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. It was taken at the estate in 
Iwate. To demonstrate the majesty of 
achieving the Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
How lovely. You carry yourself with such 
dignity and grace.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
"That was precisely what the Japanese 
racing world needed back then."

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
Racing is not merely a fierce contest. It 
is about showing everyone that it is a 
pursuit of pride—

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
—So that those who follow will not lose 
their way, I shall make a path with a 
dazzling trail of light.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
That was the only mission given to me. Now 
that I have accomplished it with all my 
might, I can say it clearly.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
Claiming the "Triple Tiara" is the 
greatest achievement in Japanese racing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was as if she were bathed in a holy 
halo. Overwhelmed by her presence, I was 
left speechless—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Left alone, my mind finally settled down. 
Reflecting back on St Lite's words... an 
idea suddenly struck me.
choice_data_list:
(I wonder if I can share what I just heard 
with the other girls too.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Especially to Classic-class Umamusume. 
Not just the Classic Triple Crown, but 
every single path holds glorious 
history... holds glory itself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing St Lite like that will inspire 
everyone to race with pride. That sight is 
sure to set the fans' hearts ablaze.
